results.title: Summer Windows
results.overview: When an ambitious teenager has different plans for her future then originally planned with her friend, she sets up a backyard concert in an attempt to get everyone together for one last time. She must decide if she will allow personal and technical issues get in the way of creating a memorable night

results.title: The Easy Way Out
results.overview: Ted returns to his hometown to find his big brother Jim at the end of his rope. But is it too late to save him?

results.title: Who Loves The Sun
results.overview: A tribute music video for the song "Who Loves The Sun" from the experimental rock band "The Velvet Underground".

results.title: Sanctuary
results.overview: In a post-apocalyptic Earth, the discovery of a cryogenically suspended woman provokes fear in a desperate village, sending a young warrior and the mysterious woman on a quest for a lost city and answers that could restore humanity.

results.title: What The Living Do
results.overview: After her girlfriend Sylvia dies of a heart attack, Ysabel — a Filipina folk healer — casts a spell to bring her back to life. But when Sylvia's body continues to rot despite resurrection, Ysabel's desperation is put to the test.

results.title: BLS - Body Life Support
results.overview: An awkward first aid instructor seeks intimacy with his student. Their questionable contact is fleeting, but for a silent witness from afar, it leaves a lifelong imprint.

results.title: RedLine
results.overview: "Ajoy" a mechanic who has a high ego and prestige wants to get more money for fame and success, along with his friend "Biluy" who is also a mechanic. "Ajoy" began to plan and invite "biluy" to join him in illegal racing at night. On the other hand, the car they used in the illegal race was their customer's car which made the situation and atmosphere that night began to worry "Biluy". Until when they finished the race everything felt in vain, to the point where they had to run from the car owner's pursuit.

results.title: Lof Joe
results.overview: A young filmmaker is left with an unfinished graduation film after the death of her lead actress.

results.title: TRAINTRACKS
results.overview: A film director and sound designer discover a disturbing sound cue hidden in the mix of their short film, forcing the director to confront demons from his past.

results.title: The Fade of Day
results.overview: Hunted by an unforeseen threat, a young father seeks refuge in the countryside. Stripped of his bearings, he questions the legacy he will offer to his newborn child.

results.title: Unmasking the Tylenol Killer
results.overview: A detective inspired by an episode of "Unsolved Mysteries" takes on the unsolved case of a death by cyanide.

results.title: Wasington
results.overview: This is the sad tale of the township of Wasington, nestled in the uttermost reaches of the northwest of the US of A.  Two young Americans had planned to travel there for an evening of light music, but that was where the trouble already began.  For what they had failed to realize was that the 6th of July was not much unlike the 4th of July after all…

results.title: DOOM II: The Super Sequel
results.overview: A Mere 11 Months after the Success of Doom, A Sequel released that blew Away the Masses. But does it Deserve the Title of a Super Sequel?  Join Cooper Berryman in the Second Doom Video, Looking into the 32 Maps of the Base Game, and Its Expansions!

results.title: My Little Hero
results.overview: Chubby always eats, walks, and plays alone—until one day, he meets a masked tree spirit named Little Tree under a giant tree. Their bond sparks laughter, friendship, and the creation of the “Little Tree Defense Squad,” where four children protect their secret green haven. But when humans threaten to destroy the tree, Little Tree must return to the forest. For the first time, Chubby steps forward, determined to find his friend and protect the world they love with his own courage.

results.title: The Way Things Seem to Be
results.original_title: The Way Things Seem to Be
results.overview: An in-depth look at documentarian Rob Nilsson.

results.title: Unearthly
results.overview: Two brothers move silently through the mundane world, carrying an unseen offering of light. As they journey from place to place, dancing and observing, subtle traces of change begin to appear, revealing how quiet presence can shift everything.

results.title: Jingle Jangle
results.overview: Two regular dudes sneak into their friend's apartment to implement the next phase in a prank war... and instead witness a murder.

results.title: Frost
results.overview: A rational, and emotionally distant female police detective investigates the disappearance of a girl in a region famous for black magic and pagan heritage. Her investigation gradually becomes a journey into a mythical world.
